title: Agreement of verifier transcripts
statement: For every natural number $m$, Boolean input $w$ of length $m+2$, Boolean proof $p$ of length $m$, and verifier seed $s$, the transcript of the short-proof verifier, after restoring the value at any query to the omitted final proof position as true, equals the transcript of the partial-sum verifier on $w$ and the proof obtained by appending true to $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a seed in the short-proof verifier's seed space
